title: Bound on Windowed Configurations
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $s,t\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose $(c_j)_{j\in\mathbb{N}}$ is a sequence of configurations on input $x$, each of the first $t+1$ configurations has every work-tape head within distance $s$ of the origin and has blank contents outside that window, and the configurations have distinct cores together with output summaries for indices $0,\ldots,t$. Then $t+1\le 3(|Q|+1)(|x|+2)3^{k(2s+1)}(2s+1)^k$, where $Q$ is the state set and $k$ is the number of work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite-state nondeterministic machine over Bool
cs is a sequence of configurations on x
For every j ≤ t, every work-head position has absolute value at most s and every tape cell outside that window is blank
The map from indices in 0,...,t to the configuration core paired with its output summary is injective
